'''Charles Lee''' of Cambridge, Massachusetts, was the first eligible entry for Puzzle 5 of the 1997 Dagobah Contest, [[Never Tell Me The Odds]]. He won a display box of white-border Premiere packs. He was the second contestant to answer Puzzle 4 and had one other Top Ten Fastest response in the contest.<ref name="sol5">[http://rothko.decipher.com/new/dagobahcontest/solution5.html The Dagobah Contest], Decipher (March 1997). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19970327214451/http://rothko.decipher.com/new/dagobahcontest/solution5.html Internet Archive]</ref>
